description: Static pages regenerated one at a time after they are generated, on a timer or on demand, without rebuilding the whole site. Name from Next.js.
Serve the cached copy immediately even if it is expired, and refresh it in the background for the next visitors. Also an HTTP `Cache-Control` directive.
How long a generated page counts as fresh (`revalidate` in seconds). A product decision: acceptable staleness vs render cost.
`revalidatePath` or `revalidateTag` called from a webhook or a mutation, so a page refreshes when its data changes instead of on a timer.
Only one regeneration per page runs at a time; concurrent requests share it instead of stampeding the data source.
A label attached to fetched data (`next: { tags: ['products'] }`) so every page that used it can be invalidated together.
